notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for in-app onboarding copilots and chat assistants. Primary goal: consistent low-latency streaming responses with deterministic token cost caps per session. Started on Hosted API; exploring Dedicated for predictable throughput once POC proves latency/cost.

Requirements (from product + infra):
- Workloads: in-app guided onboarding flows (multi-turn), help chat, tool-calls to internal APIs (account lookup, plan changes).
- Latency SLO: streaming p95 end-to-end <250ms for short responses; cold-start <150ms for existing session. Client strongly emphasizes smooth chunked streaming (UI uses partial tokens).
- Throughput: spikes during onboarding waves (50–100 concurrent agents in a region), scale to 500 concurrent in future.
- Cost sensitivity: strict token budget per user session (target $0.02–$0.08 per session). Wants automatic fallback to smaller/quantized model when cost cap approaches.
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models; want ability to route to quantized variants and fall back to cheaper model during bursts.
- Routing: policy-based routing by latency/cost/region; require predictable behavior for canary rollouts.
- Security/compliance: must integrate SSO (SAML), KMS for customer keys, audit logs for requests, support for VPC/Dedicated for production. SOC2 required.

POC plan (agreed): 2-week hosted API POC using sample onboarding flows + tool-calling. Deliverables: latency and token cost dashboard, sample automatic fallback when token budget >75% used, streaming behavior validation across desktop/mobile. After POC: price quote for Dedicated capacity + SLA addendum.

Sales notes / quotes from customer: "We need predictable latency; UX falls apart when streaming stalls" (VP Product). "If you can guarantee p95 across regions, we'll move to Dedicated" (CTO).

Open items / asks for Redwood:
- Provide recommended batching/continuous-caching config for multi-turn onboarding flows to minimize tokens.
- Example routing policy for model fallback (hosted -> quantized hosted -> Dedicated variant).
- Pricing scenario: 100k sessions/month with token caps; what Dedicated commit reduces unit cost to meet target?
- Security: sample KMS integration doc + audit log retention policies.

Stated blockers in account: legal wants explicit cost-cap contract language + SLA for streaming latency. Infosec wants proof-of-concept for KMS and audit logs before Dedicated procurement.

Internal next actions (AE/SE):
- Jamie / Ravi to schedule POC kickoff (hosting credentials + telemetry hooks) — action: send POC checklist by 2024-10-07.
- SE to prototype token-metering example in demo app (priority: streaming chunk boundaries).
- Prepare Dedicated pricing scenarios and a one-page economics slide for execs.
